file_profiles = []
schema_profiles = []

dataset_lookup = {
    dataset["dataset_id"]: dataset
    for dataset in datasets
}

for file in source_inventory:

    dataset = dataset_lookup[file["dataset_id"]]

    df = read_source_file(
        spark,
        dataset,
        file["file_path"]
    )

    row_count = df.count()

    file_profiles.append({
        "dataset_id": file["dataset_id"],
        "file_name": file["file_name"],
        "file_format": file["file_format"],
        "file_size_bytes": file["file_size_bytes"],
        "row_count": row_count,
        "column_count": len(df.columns)
    })

    for field in df.schema.fields:

        schema_profiles.append({
            "dataset_id": file["dataset_id"],
            "file_name": file["file_name"],
            "column_name": field.name,
            "data_type": field.dataType.simpleString(),
            "nullable": field.nullable
        })

file_profile_df = spark.createDataFrame(file_profiles)

schema_profile_df = spark.createDataFrame(schema_profiles)

display(file_profile_df)

display(schema_profile_df)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

dataset_summary_df = (
    file_profile_df
    .groupBy("dataset_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("total_files"),
        F.sum("row_count").alias("total_records"),
        F.sum("file_size_bytes").alias("total_bytes")
    )
    .withColumn(
        "total_size_mb",
        F.round(
            F.col("total_bytes") / (1024 ** 2),
            2
        )
    )
)

display(dataset_summary_df)
